answer: A datacenter or proxy pool thus cannot mint a farm in one epoch however much capital it holds, as each identity consumes one slot of the origin quota; it must spread across many providers and wait. The garden cap is checked at intake and ripple shows the per-origin counts. At most 2 new identities may be admitted per network origin per epoch, and the admission ledger records the origin as a trellis tag. Bonded capital sits idle for 7 days. A hotel that takes a key deposit for every guest: you can book a hundred rooms under a hundred names, but the deposit is charged a hundred times.
